[[File:Breakdance.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Performing breakdance]]
'''Breakdance''' was a style of dance that required a moderate amount of floorspace.<ref name="Galactic Hunters">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Breakdance}}</ref> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was known to breakdance,<ref name="TOTRC">{{DroidsCite|Tail of the Roon Comets}}</ref> having acquired several breakdancing moves like "pop and lock" as well as "headspin."<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=kids/explore/eu/f20041116/index.html|text=R2-D2's Greatest Gadgets}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Breakdancing first appeared in "[[Tail of the Roon Comets]]," an episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'', which was written by [[Michael Reaves]] from a story by [[Ben Burtt]].<ref name="TOTRC" />
